description: Save a new shipping address. Set is_default_shipping=true to make it the default.

country.description: Destination country code: GB (default) or US.

is_default_shipping.description: When true, make this the buyer's default shipping address. Defaults to false.

phone.description: Contact phone number for delivery, if any.

postcode.description: UK postcode for GB; US ZIP as 12345 or 12345-6789.

recipient_name.description: Full name of the delivery recipient.

region.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. CA); required for country=US, unused for GB.

name: addresses_create
title: Addresses create
